title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents
title_zh: LEGO-RL：面向编程智能体原生执行框架的强化学习
abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for coding agents increasingly relies on long-running agent harnesses to manage tool integration, repository contexts, and execution feedback. However, the native execution environments of these harnesses are inherently misaligned with policy-gradient training: environmental crashes and reward hacking corrupt outcome signals, while train-inference discrepancies decouple rollout behavior from policy updates. To address this, we present LEGO-RL, a framework that bridges native coding-agent harnesses with scalable policy-gradient optimization without modifying their internal control flow. LEGO-RL is built upon three pillars: (1) faithful optimization via in-process LLM proxying that captures raw generation streams for token-level alignment and robust trainer-side log-probability recomputation, even under harness-side compaction or re-serialization; (2) reliable execution via scalable sandbox orchestration featuring image caching and stage-wise defenses to mitigate reward hacking; and (3) observable training through an integrated plugin that automates validation and monitoring, paired with a Live UI for granular trajectory diagnostics. We evaluate LEGO-RL by training the sparse MoE model Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with GSPO across three native coding-agent harnesses. LEGO-RL improves Qwen3.5-35B-A3B across OpenHands SDK (64.0% to 70.4%), Claude Code (62.4% to 68.2%), and OpenCode (57.2% to 66.6%) on SWE-bench Verified, while maintaining a rollout-training probability correlation above 0.99.
abstract_zh: 编程智能体的强化学习日益依赖长时间运行的智能体执行框架（agent harness），以管理工具集成、代码仓库上下文和执行反馈。然而，这类框架的原生执行环境与策略梯度训练天然不匹配：环境崩溃和奖励黑客（reward hacking）会污染结果信号，而训练与推理之间的差异会导致 rollout 行为与策略更新脱节。为此，本文提出 LEGO-RL，一个无需修改框架内部控制流，即可连接原生编程智能体执行框架与可扩展策略梯度优化的框架。LEGO-RL 包含三项核心设计：第一，通过进程内 LLM 代理捕获原始生成流，实现 token 级对齐，并在训练端稳健地重新计算对数概率，即使执行框架进行了上下文压缩或重新序列化，也能保证优化忠实性；第二，通过具备镜像缓存和分阶段防御机制的可扩展沙箱编排，提高执行可靠性并缓解奖励黑客；第三，通过集成插件自动完成验证与监控，并结合 Live UI 对轨迹进行细粒度诊断，实现训练过程的可观测性。实验使用 GSPO，在三个原生编程智能体执行框架上训练稀疏 MoE 模型 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。在 SWE-bench Verified 上，LEGO-RL 将 OpenHands SDK 的成绩从 64.0% 提升至 70.4%，Claude Code 从 62.4% 提升至 68.2%，OpenCode 从 57.2% 提升至 66.6%，同时将 rollout 与训练概率的相关性维持在 0.99 以上。
key_points_zh: 无需修改 OpenHands SDK、Claude Code、OpenCode 等原生执行框架的内部控制流，即可接入可扩展的策略梯度优化。
通过进程内 LLM 代理捕获原始生成流，实现 token 级对齐和训练端对数概率重计算，缓解训练—推理不一致。
采用可扩展沙箱编排、镜像缓存及分阶段防御，提高执行稳定性并减少环境崩溃与奖励黑客造成的信号污染。
集成自动验证、训练监控插件和 Live UI，支持对智能体执行轨迹进行细粒度诊断。
在 SWE-bench Verified 上，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在三个执行框架中均取得显著提升，最高提升 9.4 个百分点，且概率相关性超过 0.99。

llm_assessment.comment: LEGO-RL directly addresses faithful, scalable, and observable RL over native coding-agent harnesses with strong cross-harness results.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: LEGO-RL直接解决了原生编程智能体框架上强化学习的保真性、可扩展性和可观测性，并取得了扎实的跨框架结果。
